title: ASML plans to give its ~45K employees globally a €20,000 bonus, issued as a share award vesting in 2030, joining other chip industry companies offering payouts (Sarah Jacob/Bloomberg)
summary: Sarah Jacob / Bloomberg: ASML plans to give its ~45K employees globally a €20,000 bonus, issued as a share award vesting in 2030, joining other chip industry companies offering payouts — ASML Holding NV will give employees globally a one-time €20,000 ($22,862) bonus, joining other firms in the chip industry …
